findings.Use case: Decks landing shell matches Gallery Decks
findings.Steps: Load Live → #decks; compare to Gallery Decks.dc.html
findings.Expected: h1 "Decks" Young Serif ~44px; muted summary with deck/sub/$ figures; rail 216px with tinted deck rows; no top header
findings.Experienced: After Load Live: h1 Decks 44px Young Serif; summary "Seven decks, all playable. 123 substitutes… $215…"; railWidth 216; deck rows D1–D7 under Decks; Brass bg #1a1815 accent #d9a441

findings.Use case: Deck tiles + New deck primary + Compare
findings.Steps: On #decks inspect grid, New deck, Compare
findings.Expected: 3-col poster tiles (radius 22px), dashed + New deck cell; Compare secondary + New deck primary brass
findings.Experienced: 8 tiles (7 decks + dashed New); New deck primary rgb(217,164,65); Compare labeled "Compare selected" and disabled until picks; grid auto-fill → 4 columns at 1440px (minmax 260px) not Gallery repeat(3,…); tileRadius 21.6px
findings.Recommended remediation: Pin Decks grid to repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr)) at desktop; rename Compare to match Gallery or keep selected-count pattern but show enabled secondary when ≥2 picks; radius 22px

findings.Use case: New deck Create / Import / Lab doors
findings.Expected: Doors: Create, Import, Lab with short blurbs
findings.Experienced: Dialog "New deck" with Create / Import / Lab options and expected blurbs

findings.Use case: Deck Overview vs Gallery Deck Page
findings.Steps: Open D6 Krenko from rail; inspect Overview
findings.Expected: Hero commander art (slight rotate), Young Serif title, stage/bracket chips, mechanics, Next/Progress/Cost bento; tabs Overview · The hundred · Upgrades · Explore · Acquire; primary-from-state

findings.Use case: Rail sub-pages Ready to add / Make the change under open deck
findings.Steps: With deck open, inspect rail under that deck
findings.Expected: Indented Ready to add and Make the change with counts under open deck on every deck tab (Gallery shell)
findings.Experienced: Rail lists D1–D7 under Decks but Ready to add / Make the change not listed under open deck (actions only on Overview row). Routes #pull and #change still work.
findings.Recommended remediation: Render C.SUBNAV.decks Ready to add / Make the change indented under current deck in rail on all deck tabs
